sources.name: libretro-database Dreamcast cheats
sources.author: libretro-database contributors and the original Dreamcast cheat authors
sources.license: CC-BY-SA-4.0 repository license; individual upstream code authors remain credited
sources.notes: The Dreamcast cheat folder is imported whole. Disc product codes come from the Redump metadata DAT of the same revision; Redump's short Sega codes (51036) are expanded to the IP.BIN form (MK-51036) and serial lists from the previous catalog are always kept. Blocks using unsupported code types, repeats or enable codes are excluded.

sources.name: MAME cheat collection (Pugsy's XML cheats)
sources.author: Pugsy and MAME cheat collection contributors
sources.license: MAME cheat XML collection by Pugsy and contributors; only plain SH4 main RAM writes are converted
sources.notes: Naomi, Naomi 2, Atomiswave and System SP romsets are matched against the arcade game table shipped with EmuCoreH (assets/catalog/arcade_games.json). Only unconditional run-state actions that write SH4 main RAM are converted to address/value codes; button conditions, ROM patches and one-shot actions are skipped.

sources.name: Dreamcast Cheat Database (bucanero)
sources.author: bucanero and the Dreamcast Cheat Database contributors
sources.notes: Action Replay CDX codes for 380+ Dreamcast revisions. Packs are generated only for disc codes the libretro packs do not already cover, so the catalog adds games instead of duplicating them. Master codes ((M)/[M]) are skipped because the core decrypts Action Replay codes itself.

sources.name: GameHacking.org Dreamcast cheats
sources.author: GameHacking.org contributors
sources.license: GameHacking.org community codes; individual hackers credited on the site
sources.notes: Crawled with scripts/crawl-gamehacking.py through the site's own code group endpoint (Chrome TLS impersonation). Includes every Dreamcast game with codes, also for discs the other sources already cover, because the app merges installed packs and GameHacking.org usually carries more cheats per game. Master and enable codes are skipped.

sources.name: libretro-database Sega device cheats
sources.author: libretro-database contributors and original cheat authors
sources.notes: Adapted by scripts/build-sega-catalog.py. Original revision filenames and block descriptions retained. Supports Genesis/32X cartridge ROM and FF0000-FFFFFE main 68000 RAM, CD FF0000-FFFFFE RAM, and SMS/GG/SG Game Genie/Pro Action Replay. Odd 68000 addresses, unsupported domains, invalid/device/master/conditional blocks excluded whole. Device execution verified with authored fixtures in EmuCoreH, individual retail game effects not independently verified. No commercial ROM data distributed.
